contracts.source: Wolfspeed press release: Infineon and Wolfspeed Expand and Extend Long-Term Silicon (10-15-2026)
contracts.signal: Expansion and extension of the existing long-term SiC wafer supply agreement between Wolfspeed and Infineon, adding 200 mm silicon carbide wafers to the existing 150 mm supply; the supply relationship spans more than 20 years. CEO Robert Feurle: Wolfspeed will 'continue to support Infineon's long-term silicon carbide needs.'
contracts.units: 200 mm SiC wafers added to the existing 150 mm supply
